unit: first table record per patient; later longitudinal organoids reserved for secondary analysis
endpoint: Objective response: CR/PR=1, SD/PD=0; other unrecognized or unavailable outcomes excluded with reason. Treatment/readout paired exactly as Table S6.
signal: log10(IC50); training pooled balanced-accuracy cutoff, per-drug cutoff only when at least4 training and both classes; drug cutoff shrunk toward pooled by n/(n+8). Right-censored IC50 >1000 treated as1000 lower bound for resistant classification; sensitivity marks threshold ambiguity.
baseline: fixed0.625 micromolar midpoint of tested concentration series; all patients released; same predictor additionally wrapped by identical sourcewise CRC for risk-matched ablation.
calibration: 12 separate patients choose smallest margin satisfying(e+1)/(n+1)<=0.1. Exact binomial training-ordered LTT at eta0.05 independently reported.
stages: Protocol and split freeze first; reveal only12 training labels, fit and hash numeric cutoffs/reference/family; reveal only12 calibration labels, freeze numeric test predictions/forecast/hash; only then reveal12 test labels. Training/calibration patients do not count as outcome-blind test patients.
blind_scope: published retrospective patients; 12 held-out outcomes unread at each upstream stage; no claim of prospectively recruited trial
decision: Compare signal gain to fixed baseline on same held-out patients; stop failed signal without retuning after test.
